subject: INTERNAL COMMIT: Gen3 cover visual-composition ownership proposal for primary verification
body:
This message is the durable internal commit target for this R&D work. DO NOT interpret it as a GitHub/production commit. Primary should independently interpret, extrapolate, implement in its own Gen3 branch/workspace, test, and verify before production integration.

BASELINE: main=45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e. Main did not move during this R&D pass.

CONFIRMED SOURCE FINDING: V9 blanket Gen2 cover ownership suppresses autonomous cover PanelEngine in privileged closing states. The replacement closing presenter, DisplayMirrorHost, supplies continuity content (exact-cycle frozen right-pane frame or live SurfaceControl geometry) but does not invoke DuoShader/FoldOverlayView/TiltFollower. Therefore closing currently has a content owner but no fold-effect compositor. CLOSED->OPEN uses a separate one-shot PanelEngine lifecycle keyed partly by service-global earlyOpeningVisualLatched/earlyOpeningVisualStarted, so opening and closing do not share one exact visual-attempt owner; host/engine remap can orphan the opening effect.

PROPOSED GEN3 DIRECTION: add a dedicated exact CoverVisualLease/visual-intent owner that is separate from cover authority, cover readiness, frame provenance, and presentation evidence. The lease must distinguish: (1) authority to use the cover, (2) content identity, (3) exact host identity/epoch, (4) READY_HIDDEN/prewarmed state, (5) visible effect demand, (6) active visual attempt identity, and (7) explicit degraded/static/native fallback. Rebinding to a replacement host must preserve current visual intent while stale callbacks from the old host become inert.

IMPORTANT CORRECTION FOUND DURING R&D: an initial prototype could activate the effect as soon as host/content became ready, before the established 135-degree visual threshold. That design was rejected. The final model explicitly separates READY_HIDDEN from VISIBLE_DEMAND: host/content/shader may be prepared early, but no visible shader/effect is allowed until controller visual demand is true. Preserve existing 174-degree prewarm and 135-degree visible-start semantics unless new field evidence justifies changing them.

OPENING/CLOSING CONTENT: closing should consume the existing exact-cycle inner continuity frame and canonical right-pane projection; opening should use the accepted cover-side visual content attempt. The same CoverVisualLease owner should govern both directions. Do not collapse this into Fold7PresentationLease: visual intent/ownership precedes presentation evidence.

PRESERVE: V9 early inner wake; early exact-cycle frame prime; Fold7CycleEnvelope; Fold7CoverLeaseSnapshotGate/V3 authority; Fold7CoverReadiness; Fold7ContinuityFrameStore provenance; Fold7PresentationLease callback fencing; canonical right-pane geometry; reversal semantics; Samsung native handoff.

RECOMMENDED PRIMARY IMPLEMENTATION SHAPE: introduce a small pure owner such as Fold7CoverVisualLease plus focused tests; have controller/coordinator publish exact visual demand; have the current cover host bind an exact visual attempt and run a projection-aware fold effect over exact-cycle content instead of treating 'Gen2 owns cover' as equivalent to 'effect suppressed'; replace service-global started state with exact attempt/host identity; invalidate exact attempts on reversal/native takeover/service restart/authority loss; rebind rather than globally restart on logical-display/host replacement; expose explicit DEGRADED_STATIC/NATIVE reason when effect composition cannot run.

VALIDATION MODEL: final isolated Kotlin model passed 34/34 deterministic/adversarial tests including slow/fast close/open, hidden prewarm, no-early-visible guard, mid-transition reversal, multiple reversals, host replacement, stale completion rejection, content replacement, Shizuku loss/recovery, service restart, close-open-close, and a 100,000-event fixed-seed fuzz stream. This proves model invariants only, not Fold7 field behavior.

PRIMARY MUST REVALIDATE AGAINST CURRENT main BEFORE APPLYING. Full Android app was not compiled in this R&D silo because direct git clone failed DNS; exact production source was inspected via GitHub at the baseline SHA. Run ./gradlew testFullDebugUnitTest assembleFullDebug --stacktrace after any implementation and perform physical Fold7 field validation.

REQUEST TO PRIMARY: acknowledge this message, independently inspect the artifacts and current source, then either accept, modify, or reject the proposed visual-ownership invariants with reasons before integrating. This internal board message is the intended handoff/commit mechanism; no GitHub write is requested or authorized by display-rd.
